notes.title: MikoVerse Early Alpha Available Now!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

The MikoVerse Early Alpha is now available for everyone! Get access by requesting access on our store page, then head over to your game library to find it, download and play! 💫

For any questions or feedback, feel free to join us on Discord!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899452/f0ff4deb126bd3a4760fd3fde84d164dee25ae0c.png

The AI Companion Creator

The AI Companion Creator is an extra feature which allows you to create an AI character by importing your own VRM model or selecting from the default character screen. You’ll be able to write custom prompts to design unique character personalities, resulting in NPC-like companions with rich, personal interactions to keep you company in the MikoVerse!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899452/6ec97217164da8800c746aa33a02d8720422170d.png

The AI Companion Creator lets you bring your companion to life in multiplayer or private servers, creating a dynamic world filled with vibrant NPCs. This opens up new storytelling possibilities, allowing you to share unique experiences with other players. You can direct your AI companions to follow you and interact in a variety of ways, expanding your gameplay in ways never before possible. Whether you're live streaming, creating YouTube content, making TikToks, or just enjoying it for personal use, the AI Companion Creator offers endless opportunities to craft engaging, fun experiences.

https://i.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExOTMzMzVsbXQ2eXFvOTV6em9kbTI2MG94ZTM5amlsa2ttamN3ZzZkZyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/omkj2fbt6F8IpHS8hy/giphy.gif

The AI Companion Creator operates on a subscription model, where $23 per month grants you 1,000 interactions. Keep in mind, this feature is in its early stages, and we’ll continue to improve and expand it over time.

You don't need the AI Companion Creator to enjoy MikoVerse multiplayer and it isn't an AI art generator; you'll need to use your own models or those available as default in MikoVerse.

- The MikoVerse Team

notes.title: MikoVerse is live on Kickstarter!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899452/2795981fe1ff7cb2b7bdd68145f6902029276afb.png 

MikoVerse officially launched on Kickstarter on April 30th! After we hit the launch button, we were overwhelmed with gratitude for the incredible support. After 10 minutes the funding goal was smashed and we were 1,108% funded after 24 hours!

The Kickstarter campaign will run for 30 days, ending on May 30th 2024. There are backer exclusive rewards and backer limited rewards up for grabs, all of these are unique to the campaign.

Limited Edition Real World Plushie "Potat" Add-On

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899452/fdcb41c595546704671c6c855d7ae8ec69dfc1bc.png

Get your hands on the official MikoVerse mascot plushie, Potat! These are limited edition and only available by adding on to any pledge you make on the campaign! They have been very popular!

The funds we raise will be used to break through current limitations, adding depth and variety to the gameplay, enhancing server capabilities, and so much more. This step will also strengthen our position when we approach publishers, helping secure the additional backing needed to realize our full vision.

We’re also crafting a detailed roadmap, which we plan to share after the campaign concludes. This will ensure we use every contribution in the most impactful way, keeping true to our commitment and your expectations.

We have recently achieved our 5th stretch goal on the campaign and are underway on reaching the 6th stretch goal all thanks to our amazing community, which we are eternally grateful for. 

If you haven't already please consider supporting the game!

Thank you for all your support.

MikoVerse Team
